articles.title: Crypto's campaign efforts see rare loss, but crypto roster in Congress likely to grow
articles.snippet: The leading industry PAC, Fairshake, put $2 million into a Detroit Democratic primary but came up short, even as several PAC-backed candidates won elsewhere.

articles.title: Coldcard exploit could boost demand for regulated bitcoin exposure, analysts say
articles.snippet: Cantor sees positive read-through for crypto custody providers, while FRNT says the breach could drive some investors toward bitcoin ETFs.

articles.title: Nomura’s Laser Digital backs ZIGChain for onchain private credit push in UAE
articles.snippet: Laser’s investment in ZIGChain is understood to be in the single-digit millions.

articles.title: Ondo Finance hires former Blockchain.com CFO Adam Schlisman
articles.snippet: The tokenized-assets firm appointed ex-Blockchain.com and Monashee executive as finance chief as it expands its onchain capital markets business.

articles.title: SpaceX extends decline to 11% on lockup expiration and capex spending fears
articles.snippet: The company reported no BTC sales in the second quarter, but shares fell before the open as investors focused on capital spending, free cash flow pressure and a looming insider lockup expiry.
